title: Braze Platform Engineering | Curated introductions
intro: Three former Grubhub engineers with complementary experience in internal developer platforms, distributed processing, and infrastructure reliability. Candidate interest and specialized technical requirements should be confirmed.

items.note: John Burns: JVM platform tooling, Gradle, developer enablement and shared engineering frameworks. Referrer reports recent Netflix layoff. Validate Kubernetes operators, Ruby/Sidekiq, and job-processing framework ownership.

Jesus Alonso (Jeezus): Java/Kotlin services, Kafka (~12k events/second in prior integration), asynchronous workloads, Cassandra optimization, build automation. Validate Kubernetes operators and Ruby/Sidekiq.
Lonnie Baldwin: runtime engineering, Kubernetes, Terraform, GitOps, observability and infrastructure automation. Validate recent hands-on distributed application framework development.
